_comment: B15-22 S8 amendment for the B15-29 P-1 probe verification correction (Gate A A1a W0, 2026-11-12; Bones 25). Test-only probe section of lib/session-revocation.ts: every read-back verification in runAuthorityProbe becomes an identical-canonical-byte onlyIfMatch confirmation (raw 200, exactly the supplied ETag; Bones 26), evaluated at the store's origin, because under connectLambda every read is an eventual edge read. Product session logic (sign-in, checkSession, sign-out, recovery) and runCheckShapeProbe are unchanged. ONE change, chained from the bytes S8a-S8g expect; no addition. Earlier manifests and amendments are unchanged. Hashes are LF-normalized.

netlify/functions/lib/session-revocation.reason: runAuthorityProbe only (Bones 26): the four read-back checks (steps 2, 4, 5, 7) become identical-canonical-byte onlyIfMatch CONFIRMS that pass only on a raw 200 answering exactly the supplied ETag; the A->winner and winner->REVOKED transitions must answer canonical CHANGED ETags; REVOKED is confirmed after its write; both pre-revocation ETags (e1, eW) must be refused; every existing status / single-winner / loser-412 / canonical-ETag condition is kept; safe per-step diagnostics (no ETag value). The read helper is removed. No other function changes.
